description: Per-market product-choice paths (CMP-036, ADR-0067). A PLATFORM-DEFAULT fact may back a locked pack path only if the path exactly equals a listed path; a listed path authorises neither an ancestor nor a descendant. Entries are reviewed one by one; an entry marked provisional is not settled.
